payload.friendly_name: Planning lane writes to the Mission branch before landing
payload.purpose_context: Today a Mission created without an explicit topology writes its planning artifacts to its topic branch, but implement sends planning work packages to the target branch and the move into review looks for their work there. Work in the wrong place is refused or reviewed from the wrong branch, so operators force moves by hand (#7860). One rule removes that friction without weakening the evidence check.
payload.purpose_tldr: Planning work packages of a default Mission are written, reviewed and evidenced on one branch: the Mission branch until it lands.

options: Default Missions before landing (topic branch is the write branch); explicit topologies and landed Missions unchanged
payload.question: Which Missions does the one write-branch rule change?

options: Review-range folding onto the shared reader (after #5604), pre-review gate coverage (#6851), #7856 attribution
payload.question: What stays out of this Mission?

options: Guidance only: refusal names the fix (move the commit to the Mission branch) plus a doctor/upgrade notice
Transition window: also accept target-branch planning work for WPs claimed before the upgrade
payload.question: How are Missions already in flight handled when planning work was committed on the target under the old implement guidance?

payload.final_answer: Default Missions before landing (topic branch is the write branch); explicit topologies and landed Missions unchanged. Source: operator ruling A' 2026-11-25 on #7860.
Review-range folding onto the shared reader (after #5604), pre-review gate coverage (#6851), #7856 attribution. Source: operator ruling A' 2026-11-25 (folding deferred until #5604).

Guidance only: the refusal detects owned changes that exist only on the target and names the fix (cherry-pick onto the Mission branch, or --attest-no-implementation), plus a release note. Source: operator ruling 2026-11-25 on #7860.

options: The commit on the Mission branch that introduced the WP window-opening status event (durable, same derivation as the review range Q10/Q12)
Move the planning pin onto the Mission branch
payload.question: Where does a default Mission's planning evidence window start (FR-010)?

payload.final_answer: The commit on the Mission branch that introduced the WP window-opening status event (its claim). Source: operator ruling 2026-11-25 on #7860; engineering alignment confirmed; 5 WPs.
